# Dis-non-et-je-te-baise
Veux tu êtres ma Valentine
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fr">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Veux-tu être ma Valentine ? 💕</title>
    <style>
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Georgia', serif;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
            min-height: 100vh;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            position: relative;
            padding: 20px;
        }

        /* Floating hearts animation */
        .heart {
            position: absolute;
            font-size: 30px;
            animation: float 6s infinite;
            opacity: 0;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        @keyframes float {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(100vh) rotate(0deg);
                opacity: 0;
            }
            10% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
            90% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(-100vh) rotate(360deg);
                opacity: 0;
            }
        }

        .container {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
            padding: 50px 40px;
            border-radius: 30px;
            box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
            text-align: center;
            max-width: 700px;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 10;
            animation: fadeIn 1s ease-in;
        }

        @keyframes fadeIn {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: scale(0.8);
            }
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: scale(1);
            }
        }

        .rose {
            font-size: 3em;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            animation: spin 3s linear infinite;
        }

        @keyframes spin {
            from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
            to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
        }

        h1 {
            color: #c94b4b;
            font-size: 2.5em;
            margin-bottom: 30px;
            text-shadow: 2px 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
        }

        .photo-gallery {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 15px;
            margin: 30px 0;
            max-width: 500px;
            margin-left: auto;
            margin-right: auto;
        }

        .photo-gallery img {
            width: 100%;
            height: 200px;
            object-fit: cover;
            border-radius: 15px;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
            transition: transform 0.3s ease;
        }

        .photo-gallery img:hover {
            transform: scale(1.05);
        }

        .poem {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffeef8 0%, #fff5f5 100%);
            padding: 25px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            margin: 30px 0;
            border-left: 4px solid #f5576c;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
        }

        .poem p {
            color: #555;
            font-size: 1.1em;
            line-height: 1.8;
            font-style: italic;
            margin: 8px 0;
        }

        .message {
            color: #555;
            font-size: 1.2em;
            line-height: 1.6;
            margin-bottom: 30px;
        }

        .buttons-container {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 15px;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            margin-top: 30px;
            position: relative;
            min-height: 150px;
        }

        button {
            padding: 15px 40px;
            font-size: 1.1em;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 50px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            font-weight: bold;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
        }

        .yesBtn {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f093fb 0%, #f5576c 100%);
            color: white;
            animation: pulse 2s infinite;
        }

        @keyframes pulse {
            0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); }
            50% { transform: scale(1.05); }
        }

        .yesBtn:hover {
            transform: scale(1.15) !important;
            box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(245, 87, 108, 0.4);
        }

        #noBtn {
            background: #e0e0e0;
            color: #999;
            font-size: 0.7em;
            padding: 8px 20px;
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 10px;
            right: 10px;
        }

        #noBtn:hover {
            background: #d0d0d0;
        }

        .celebration {
            display: none;
            animation: celebrate 0.6s ease-in;
        }

        @keyframes celebrate {
            0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); }
            50% { transform: scale(1.1); }
        }

        .celebration h2 {
            color: #f5576c;
            font-size: 2.5em;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .celebration p {
            color: #555;
            font-size: 1.3em;
            margin-bottom: 30px;
        }

        .celebration-emoji {
            font-size: 4em;
            animation: bounce 1s infinite;
        }

        @keyframes bounce {
            0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
            50% { transform: translateY(-20px); }
        }

        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            .container {
                padding: 30px 20px;
            }
            
            h1 {
                font-size: 2em;
            }
            
            .photo-gallery {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
            
            .photo-gallery img {
                height: 250px;
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="container">
        <div id="question">
            <div class="rose">🌹</div>
            <h1>Veux-tu être ma Valentine ? 💕</h1>
            
            <div class="photo-gallery">
                <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Notre moment ensemble">
                <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Notre moment ensemble">
                <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Notre moment ensemble">
                <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Notre moment ensemble">
            </div>

            <div class="poem">
                <p>Chaque moment passé avec toi illumine ma journée,</p>
                <p>Ton sourire est la plus belle des mélodies.</p>
                <p>Dans tes yeux je trouve la paix et la joie,</p>
                <p>Et mon cœur ne bat que pour toi.</p>
                <p></p>
                <p>Alors en cette Saint-Valentin si spéciale,</p>
                <p>Je te demande avec tout mon cœur loyal :</p>
                <p>Accepterais-tu d'être ma Valentine ?</p>
                <p>Et de rendre cette journée encore plus divine ? 💖</p>
            </div>

            <p class="message">
                Qu'en dis-tu ? 😊
            </p>

            <div class="buttons-container">
                <button class="yesBtn" onclick="sayYes()">Oui ! 💖</button>
                <button class="yesBtn" onclick="sayYes()">Bien sûr ! 💕</button>
                <button class="yesBtn" onclick="sayYes()">Évidemment ! 💝</button>
                <button class="yesBtn" onclick="sayYes()">Avec plaisir ! ✨</button>
                <button class="yesBtn" onclick="sayYes()">Absolument ! 🌹</button>
                <button id="noBtn">non...</button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div id="celebration" class="celebration">
            <div class="celebration-emoji">🎉💕✨</div>
            <h2>Yaaaaay ! 🥳</h2>
            <p>Tu viens de me rendre super heureux ! 😊</p>
            <p>Hâte de passer ce moment spécial avec toi ! 💝</p>
            <div class="photo-gallery" style="margin-top: 30px;">
                <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Nous">
                <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Nous">
                <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Nous">
                <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Nous">
            </div>
            <div class="celebration-emoji" style="margin-top: 30px;">❤️🌹❤️</div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        // Create floating hearts
        function createHeart() {
            const heart = document.createElement('div');
            heart.classList.add('heart');
            heart.innerHTML = '❤️';
            heart.style.left = Math.random() * 100 + 'vw';
            heart.style.animationDuration = (Math.random() * 3 + 4) + 's';
            heart.style.animationDelay = Math.random() * 2 + 's';
            document.body.appendChild(heart);

            setTimeout(() => {
                heart.remove();
            }, 8000);
        }

        // Create hearts continuously
        setInterval(createHeart, 500);

        // Yes button function
        function sayYes() {
            document.getElementById('question').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('celebration').style.display = 'block';
            
            // Create extra hearts celebration
            for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
                setTimeout(createHeart, i * 100);
            }
        }

        // No button logic
        const noBtn = document.getElementById('noBtn');
        const container = document.querySelector('.container');
        let noBtnClicks = 0;

        noBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            noBtnClicks++;
            
            // Make "No" button run away
            const containerRect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
            const buttonRect = noBtn.getBoundingClientRect();
            
            const maxX = containerRect.width - buttonRect.width - 100;
            const maxY = containerRect.height - buttonRect.height - 100;
            
            const randomX = Math.random() * maxX;
            const randomY = Math.random() * maxY;
            
            noBtn.style.position = 'absolute';
            noBtn.style.left = randomX + 'px';
            noBtn.style.top = randomY + 'px';
            
            // Make yes buttons glow more
            const yesBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.yesBtn');
            yesBtns.forEach(btn => {
                const currentScale = 1 + (noBtnClicks * 0.1);
                btn.style.transform = `scale(${currentScale})`;
            });
            
            // Change messages
            const messages = [
                "Oups ! Le bouton 'non' est timide... 😊",
                "Il y a plein de 'oui' qui t'attendent ! 💕",
                "Le destin essaie de te dire quelque chose... 😉",
                "Regarde tous ces 'oui' magnifiques ! ✨",
                "Je crois que c'est un signe ! 💝"
            ];
            
            if (noBtnClicks <= messages.length) {
                document.querySelector('.message').textContent = messages[noBtnClicks - 1];
            }
            
            // After 5 clicks, make "No" button disappear
            if (noBtnClicks >= 5) {
                noBtn.style.display = 'none';
                document.querySelector('.message').innerHTML = 
                    "Le destin a parlé... 😊<br>Tous les chemins mènent au 'oui' ! 💖";
            }
        });

        // Prevent clicking through to container
        noBtn.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
            if (noBtnClicks > 0) {
                const containerRect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
                const buttonRect = noBtn.getBoundingClientRect();
                
                const maxX = containerRect.width - buttonRect.width - 100;
                const maxY = containerRect.height - buttonRect.height - 100;
                
                const randomX = Math.random() * maxX;
                const randomY = Math.random() * maxY;
                
                noBtn.style.left = randomX + 'px';
                noBtn.style.top = randomY + 'px';
            }
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
